description: Find experiments, collaborations, and facilities in INSPIRE-HEP (ATLAS, CMS, DUNE, Belle II, …) by name, accelerator, or INSPIRE legacy name (CERN-LHC-CMS); digits alone look up an experiment recid. Each record carries the accelerator, host institutions, collaboration and subgroups, classification, lifecycle dates (proposed, approved, started, completed, ongoing), INSPIRE's paper count, a description, and a literatureQuery to pass to cern_inspire_search_literature or cern_inspire_get_citation_summary for the experiment's papers.

query.description: Experiment, collaboration, accelerator, or facility name (ATLAS, LHCb, Tevatron), an INSPIRE legacy name (CERN-LHC-CMS), or an experiment recid (digits only).

name: cern_inspire_search_experiments

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_query`: INSPIRE answered 400 to a parameter value it refuses. `inspire_rate_limited`: INSPIRE returned 429 after the pacer and retries. `pacer_shed`: The server's outbound INSPIRE queue could not start the request within the call's remaining budget. `upstream_unreadable`: The INSPIRE body exceeded the byte ceiling, was HTML where JSON was expected, or was invalid JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

experiments.description: Matching experiment records, in INSPIRE relevance order.

accelerator.description: Accelerator the experiment runs at, when any.

collaboration.description: The collaboration running the experiment, when recorded.

core.description: True when INSPIRE marks the record as core HEP.

dateCompleted.description: Date completed; omitted while ongoing or when unrecorded.

recid.description: INSPIRE institution record ID, when linked; pass affid:N, N being this ID, as the query of cern_inspire_search_literature or cern_inspire_get_citation_summary for the institution's papers.

legacyName.description: INSPIRE legacy name (e.g. CERN-LHC-ATLAS), the key literatureQuery uses.

literatureQuery.description: Literature query selecting this experiment's papers; pass to cern_inspire_search_literature, or as query to cern_inspire_get_citation_summary. Absent when the record has no legacy name, or the name holds a quote or backslash that cannot sit inside the query's quoted clause.

numberOfPapers.description: INSPIRE's stored paper count; it can trail the number of records literatureQuery matches.

ongoing.description: True when INSPIRE marks the experiment as still running, false when it records a completion date; omitted when INSPIRE records neither, so the status is unknown.

shortName.description: Short form of the name, when recorded.

description.description: Label INSPIRE gives the URL, when any.

notice.description: Guidance on an empty or capped result.

totalCount.description: Total experiment records the query matched.

truncated.description: True when more records matched than were returned.

title: Search INSPIRE experiments
